senses.gloss: गयः [gayḥ], 1 N. of the people living round Gayā and the district inhabited by them.
N. of an Asura.
Wealth.
House, household, family.
Offspring, progeny.
The sky.
One's own place or abode.-या N. of a city in Behar which is a place of pilgrimage.
गायः [gāyḥ], [गै भावे घञ्] Singing, a song; यथाविधानेन पठन् सामगायमविच्युतम् Y.3.112; Bhāg.1.9.26.
गायः [gāyḥ], A song; यथाविधानेन पठन् सामगायमविच्युतम् Y.3.112.
गयस्फान [gayasphāna], a. Ved. Promoting domestic wealth; गय- स्फानो अमीवहा Rv.1.91.12.
गायकः [gāyakḥ], [गै-ण्वुल्] A singer, musician; न नटा न विटा न गायकाः Bh.3.27.
An actor.
गायत्र [gāyatra], a. Consisting in or connected with गायत्री; गर्गा- द्यदुकुलाचार्याद्गायत्रं व्रतमास्थितौ Bhāg.1.45.29. -त्रम् A song or hymn; एतद्गायत्रं प्राणेषु प्रोतम् Ch. Up.2.11.1.
गायत्रिन् [gāyatrin], a. (-णी f.) One who sings hymns, especially of the Sāmaveda; गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणो Rv.1.1.1.
गायत्री [gāyatrī], 1 A Vedic metre of 24 syllables; गायत्री छन्द- सामहम् Bg.1.35.

N. of a very sacred verse repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his Sandhyā (morning and evening devotions) and on other occasions also. Great sins even are said to be expiated by a pious repetition of this verse, which is as follows: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् Rv.3.62.1.
A number of mystical verses in Tantra literature.
N. of Durgā, Ks.53.172. -त्रम् A hymn composed and recited in the Gāyatrī metre. -Comp. -मन्त्रः prayers connected with the गायत्री. -वल्लभः an epithet of Śiva.
गायनः [gāyanḥ], (-नी f.) [गै-ल्युट्] A singer; गायनैश्च विरोविण्यो वादनैश्च तथापरैः । विरेजुर्विपुलास्तत्र सर्वरत्नसमन्विताः ॥ Rām.1.18. 19; तथैव तत्पौरुषगायनीकृताः N.1.13; Bh.3.27 v. l.
नम् Singing a song.
Practising singing as a means of subsistence.
